Product Features

  • A good bed not only provides a place to rest and relax, but also storage space for your most prized possessions. Hidden, spacious storage keeps things tidy. With a simple pull of the lever, the cleverly designed storage compartments open. Your favourite pieces, stacks of books and seasonal clothing can be stored elegantly and stylishly. Even the smallest things find their place here.
  • The embedded mattress construction guarantees restful sleep. It gently yet firmly adapts to the contours of your body and offers perfect stability even when children are playing or you are enjoying a romantic evening. More than just a piece of furniture – the basis for safe and comfortable sleep.
  • The 12 cm thick, extra thick headrests provide optimal back support, whether you're reading in the evening or chatting with your partner at the weekend. This headboard is like a second sofa in the bedroom.
  • The ergonomic headboard adapts to the curves of the body. The slight inclination optimizes the pressure distribution for the back and neck. The tilt function allows the spine to relax naturally and thus prevents neck and shoulder pain caused by lying down for long periods of time. The result is a restful and long-lasting sleep.
  • High-quality cover: The cover is made of bouclé.The bouclé fabric feels soft and delicate and thus offers a pleasant and comfortable lying feeling. It stores heat excellently and thus provides cosy warmth in the cold season. In addition, it is elastic and dimensionally stable.
